question: What agency is being attributed such that the yoginī named by will is said to extend up to Māyā by the will of the supreme and through the siddhas?
premises: The yoginī named Icchā is named.
This is said to occur by supreme will and in relation to the siddhas.
inference: The yoginī Icchā is presented as extending up to Māyā through supreme will, in association with the siddhas.
uncertainties: The precise role of the siddhas is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, by supreme will, extends up to Māyā through the siddhas.
